doctrine: Holiday is a separate lane. Personal is a separate lane. They may use similar theme-matching mechanics, but Holiday is never Personal and Personal is never Holiday.
rules: Holiday remains its own independent lane.
Personal remains its own independent lane.
Holiday may use theme, feeling, metadata, MetaGrab tags, and admin filters to collect candidates.
No track, PIX, KK, CI, or II is tied to any holiday because of prior use.
No prior holiday campaign becomes metadata truth.
A holiday may attach to an item only if the holiday is in the actual title or admin explicitly marks it.
Christmas is not automatic; it also requires title support or admin marking.
Thank You remains a neutral PIX/track title.
Ring the Bell remains a neutral PIX/track title.
separation_rule: Holiday and Personal are parallel lanes, not the same lane.
